entries.title: Files one crewmate hands another are no longer lost when its task closes
entries.body: A crewmate can pass files it found to another task. Those files used to be deleted as soon as the first task closed, so a hand-over that came a moment later found nothing. They now stay for a week after the close, like the task's other kept files, and longer while work that builds on it is still open.
entries.noPicture: This changes how long handed files are kept, not anything on screen.
